items.title: Fake news game confers psychological resistance against online misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In a novel attempt to address this issue, we designed a psychological intervention in the form of an online browser game. In the game, players take on the role of a fake news producer and learn to master six documented techniques commonly used in the production of misinformation
judge.evidence_empirical: We conducted a large-scale evaluation of the game with N = 15,000 participants in a pre-post gameplay design.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) para combater desinformação, sem focar em temas proibidos (COVID, vacinas, eleições). O método (pré-pós) e a amostra estão corretamente identificados e o achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Good News about Bad News: Gamified Inoculation Boosts Confidence and Cognitive Immunity Against Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: A recent example is the Bad News game, an online fake news game in which players learn about six common misinformation techniques.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using a 2 (treatment vs. control) × 2 (pre vs. post) mixed design (N = 196) we measure participants’ ability to spot misinformation techniques in 18 fake headlines before and after playing Bad News.
judge.reason: O artigo trata de um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) contra desinformação, sem focar em temas proibidos (COVID, vacinas, eleições). O estudo é empírico (experimento com grupo controle), o método está correto e o achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Disentangling Item and Testing Effects in Inoculation Research on Online Misinformation: Solomon Revisited

judge.evidence_topic: This study addresses two unanswered methodological questions about a widely adopted online “fake news” inoculation game, Bad News.
judge.evidence_empirical: We investigate both item and testing effects in two online studies (total N = 2,159) using the Bad News game.
judge.reason: O artigo trata do jogo Bad News, que é um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, atendendo ao tema. O estudo é empírico, utilizando dois experimentos online com desenho de Solomon. O método descrito no resumo condiz com o que foi extraído. O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Technique-based inoculation against real-world misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments (total n = 2188; convenience sample recruited via the Bad News online game platform)
judge.evidence_empirical: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments
judge.reason: O artigo utiliza o jogo Bad News para testar a inoculação contra desinformação, o que está alinhado ao tema. O estudo é empírico (dois experimentos) e os achados extraídos refletem fielmente o resumo.

items.title: Game-based inoculation versus graphic-based inoculation to combat misinformation: a randomized controlled trial

judge.evidence_topic: This study employed inoculation theory and developed an interactive game to help the public counter misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: A total of 180 Chinese participants were randomly assigned to game-based inoculation, graphic-based inoculation, and control groups.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (RCT) sobre um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, alinhado aos critérios. O achado principal está corretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: How to “inoculate” against multimodal misinformation: A conceptual replication of Roozenbeek and van der Linden (2020)

judge.evidence_topic: We developed a game called Cat Park , in which players learn about five manipulation techniques (trolling, emotional manipulation, amplification, polarization, and conspiracism), and how misinformation can spread through images.
judge.evidence_empirical: To test the game’s efficacy, we conducted a conceptual replication ( N = 380) of Roozenbeek and van der Linden’s 2020 study about Harmony Square , with the same study design, item set, and hypotheses.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (experimento) com o jogo Cat Park, que não trata de temas excluídos (COVID, vacinas, eleições). O achado principal reflete corretamente os resultados descritos no resumo.

items.title: Bad News in the civics classroom: How serious gameplay fosters teenagers’ ability to discern misinformation techniques

judge.evidence_topic: Although the serious game Bad News has been used to inoculate citizens against misinformation, it has not been formally evaluated in traditional classrooms. We therefore evaluated its impact on 516 upper-secondary Swedish students
judge.evidence_empirical: We therefore evaluated its impact on 516 upper-secondary Swedish students playing individually, paired, or with the whole class.
judge.reason: O artigo trata de um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) contra desinformação, sem abordar os temas excluídos. O estudo é empírico, com 516 estudantes, e o método de avaliação pré e pós-intervenção está alinhado com o resumo. O achado principal é sustentado pelo texto.

items.title: Feedback exercises boost discernment of misinformation for gamified inoculation interventions.

judge.evidence_topic: Previous research has found that 'inoculation' games such as Bad News and Harmony Square help build cognitive resistance against misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: We address these issues in two preregistered lab experiments (N1 = 191, N2 = 321) and four quasi-experimental in-game surveys implemented in Harmony Square (N3 = 559) and Bad News (N4 = 2,558, N5 = 419, N6 = 882).
judge.reason: O artigo aborda jogos de inoculação (Bad News e Harmony Square) contra desinformação, sem tratar de temas excluídos. O estudo é empírico, utilizando experimentos e quase-experimentos. O método descrito está correto. O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Gamified Inoculation Against Misinformation in India: A Randomized Control Trial

judge.evidence_topic: We report the results of a game-based intervention against misinformation in India. The game is based on the mechanism of psychological inoculation
judge.evidence_empirical: the present study conducted in north India (n = 757) did not replicate earlier findings.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um ensaio controlado randomizado (RCT) sobre uma intervenção baseada em jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, sem abordar os temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política). Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Re-examining the bad news game: No evidence of improved discrimination of Indian true and fake news headlines

judge.evidence_topic: Gamified inoculation interventions such as the Bad News game are a widely adopted approach to mitigating the influence of misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: The current preregistered study used the same design as Iyengar et al., although participants of Indian nationality ( N = 150) were recruited via Prolific
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico sobre o jogo Bad News, não se enquadra nas exclusões (COVID, eleições, etc.) e o achado principal está diretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Mixed News about the Bad News Game

judge.evidence_topic: Basol et al. (2020) tested the “the Bad News Game” (BNG), an app designed to improve ability to spot false claims on social media... Here, four teams of undergraduate psychology students each attempted an extended replication of Basol et al.
judge.evidence_empirical: Here, four teams of undergraduate psychology students each attempted an extended replication of Basol et al., using updated versions of the original Bad News game.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico de replicação (não uma reanálise) sobre o jogo Bad News, sem tratar dos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política). Os dados extraídos refletem corretamente o método e o achado principal do resumo.

items.title: The fake news game: actively inoculating against the risk of misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: we developed a ‘fake news game’ in which participants are actively tasked with creating a news article about a strongly politicized issue (the European refugee crisis)
judge.evidence_empirical: we conducted a randomized field study (N = 95)
judge.reason: O estudo é um experimento randomizado (estudo de campo) que avalia um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. O achado principal está corretamente sintetizado e sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: MAthE the Game: A Serious Game for Education and Training in News Verification

judge.evidence_topic: the objective of this study is to present the design and the development of an educational web application for learning the necessary steps towards the detection of bogus content
judge.evidence_empirical: this paper reports the results of a randomized online field study (n = 111)
judge.reason: O artigo trata de um jogo educativo para verificação de notícias, enquadrando-se no tema de inoculação contra desinformação. O estudo é empírico (randomizado), o método descrito no resumo condiz com o extraído e o achado principal é sustentado pelo texto.

items.title: Enhancing Information Literacy for Spotting Fake News: A Study on the Efficacy of a Serious Game for M-Learning Across Different Age Groups

judge.evidence_topic: In the game, players take on the role of librarians who must evaluate news from social media and newspapers, determine whether it is fake or true... The results revealed that using a serious game of “How to Spot Fake News” can improve the knowledge of information literacy needed to evaluate online sources of information.
judge.evidence_empirical: To evaluate the game, we did a randomized online field study, including quantitative research based on pre-posttests involving 351 participants.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (randomizado, pré-pós teste) sobre um jogo educativo para letramento informacional, sem abordar os temas excluídos (COVID, vacinas, eleições). Os dados extraídos (tipo de estudo, método, amostra e achado) estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Prebunking interventions based on the psychological theory of “inoculation” can reduce susceptibility to misinformation across cultures.

judge.evidence_topic: This study finds that the online “fake news” game, Bad News, can confer psychological resistance against common online misinformation strategies (e.g., conspiracy theories, manipulating emotions, political polarization) across different cultures (Sweden, German, Poland, and Greece).
judge.evidence_empirical: This study finds that the online “fake news” game, Bad News, can confer psychological resistance against common online misinformation strategies (e.g., conspiracy theories, manipulating emotions, political polarization) across different cultures (Sweden, German, Poland, and Greece).
judge.reason: O artigo trata de um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) contra desinformação, é um estudo empírico, o método descrito é consistente com o resumo e o achado principal é sustentado pelo texto.

items.title: Investigating the long-term impact of misinformation interventions in upper secondary education

judge.evidence_topic: we tested three types of interventions: prebunking through the Bad News game
judge.evidence_empirical: Using an experimental design with 459 students in authentic classroom settings
judge.reason: O artigo testa o jogo Bad News em um experimento com estudantes, atendendo aos critérios de tema e método. O achado extraído é sustentado diretamente pelo resumo.

items.title: Playing an Augmented Reality Escape Game Promotes Learning About Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we focus on Escape Fake , an augmented reality (AR) escape game developed for use in media literacy education.
judge.evidence_empirical: we conducted a field study using a pretest-posttest research design. A total of 28 students (14 girls, mean age = 14.71 years) participated.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré-teste e pós-teste) sobre um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) voltado para a alfabetização midiática e detecção de notícias falsas, o que está alinhado com o pedido. O achado extraído reflete fielmente o resultado reportado no resumo.

items.title: Effekte eines Augmented Reality Escape Games auf das Lernen über Fake News Effects of an Augmented Reality Escape Game on Learning about Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: In dieser Studie wird untersucht, ob auch ein Augmented-Reality-basiertes Escape Game Lernziele adressieren kann, die für den Unterricht über Fake News relevant sind.
judge.evidence_empirical: Um diese Frage zu beantworten, wurde ein Vortest-Nachtest Design mit 27 Schüler:innen durchgeführt.

items.title: Can pre-service teachers learn about fake news by playing an augmented reality escape game?

judge.evidence_topic: The aim of this study is to address this gap by examining whether pre-service teachers can learn about fake news using the augmented reality escape game Escape Fake.
judge.evidence_empirical: To investigate this question, a pre-/post-test design was conducted with 45 pre-service teachers (four males, mean age=22.59 years, standard deviation=1.80).
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré/pós-teste) sobre um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) para combater desinformação, sem abordar os temas excluídos (COVID, eleições, etc.). Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: With Games Against Fake News – Developing Critical Thinking with the Help of the Card Game Follow Me

judge.evidence_topic: This study aims to validate the contribution of the game Follow me in building resilience to fake news through an experiment on a sample of 130 secondary school students from six different schools.
judge.evidence_empirical: This study aims to validate the contribution of the game Follow me in building resilience to fake news through an experiment on a sample of 130 secondary school students from six different schools.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um experimento empírico com 130 estudantes para avaliar o jogo de cartas 'Follow me' como ferramenta de resiliência contra desinformação, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. O achado principal reflete com precisão os resultados apresentados no resumo.

items.title: Breaking the News: Taking the Roles of Influencer vs. Journalist in a LLM-Based Game for Raising Misinformation Awareness

judge.evidence_topic: We created a Player vs. Player (PvP) game in which participants attempt to generate or debunk misinformation to convince the public opinion represented by LLM.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using a within-subjects mixed-methods study design (N=47), we found that this game significantly raised participants' media literacy and improved their ability to identify misinformation.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um jogo sério (PvP baseado em LLM) para combater desinformação, o que se alinha ao tema. O estudo é empírico (métodos mistos, N=47) e o achado principal está literalmente presente no resumo.

items.title: Active inoculation boosts attitudinal resistance against extremist persuasion techniques: a novel approach towards the prevention of violent extremism

judge.evidence_topic: For this preregistered study, we developed and tested a novel online game, Radicalise , which aims to combat the effectiveness of online recruitment strategies used by extremist organizations, based on the principles of active psychological inoculation.
judge.evidence_empirical: To test the game's effectiveness, we conducted a preregistered 2 × 2 mixed (pre–post) randomized controlled experiment ( n = 291) with two outcome measures.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um jogo de inoculação (Radicalise) contra técnicas de recrutamento extremista, o que se enquadra no tema solicitado. O estudo é empírico (experimento randomizado), o método descrito no resumo coincide com o extraído, e o achado principal é sustentado pelo texto do resumo.

items.title: Inoculation Strategies for Misinformation Resistance: A Multidimensional Intervention Approach

judge.evidence_topic: This study designed a card-based tabletop prototype and developed the online game version. We recruited 80 participants to examine the effects of age (younger and older adults), interaction levels (game-based and text-based), and inoculation forms (active and passive inoculation) on attitude changes toward misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: We recruited 80 participants to examine the effects of age (younger and older adults), interaction levels (game-based and text-based), and inoculation forms (active and passive inoculation) on attitude changes toward misinformation.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico com 80 participantes utilizando jogos para combater desinformação (AIGC), sem abordar temas proibidos. Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: ENHANCING MEDIA AND INFORMATION LITERACY THROUGH EXPERIENTIAL GAME-BASED LEARNING

judge.evidence_topic: This study explores how Malaysian public research universities (MRUs) utilise Islamic philanthropic instruments—specifically waqf and zakat—to support student teaching and learning.
judge.evidence_empirical: A qualitative case study approach was employed. In-depth interviews (both in-person and online) were conducted with nine informants from five selected MRUs
judge.reason: O artigo trata de instrumentos filantrópicos islâmicos (waqf e zakat) em universidades, não de jogos contra desinformação. Os dados extraídos (tamanho da amostra, método e achados) são completamente divergentes do resumo fornecido, que descreve um estudo qualitativo com 9 informantes, e não um experimento com 95 participantes.
